stop_model: stop = resistance x 0.94 (~6% below the trigger); relative-strength calls floored at 1.5x the 10-day ATR below the trigger
disclaimer: Educational content only, not investment advice. A live, forward-only record of the site's own published calls -- nothing backfilled. Each call is graded by whether price hit +1R before the stop within 10 trading days.

payoff.note: Measured over the same published calls, held 10 bars with no stop and no target, so the size of winners and losers is visible. The graded record above clips every win to +1R, which makes payoff ratio 1.0 by construction. This is a description of payoff shape, NOT a recommended exit -- no-stop holding was tested and failed.

money.note: Each call's 10-bar close-to-close return minus the mean return of every stock in the scanned universe on the same date in the same ATR-percent quintile. Money, not R; random-stock baseline, not the index. t is clustered by call date.

metrics.note: Three-way R counts expired calls at their mark-to-market, not as losses. Profit factor is gross gains / gross losses on the hold-to-window returns. Drawdowns are of a daily equity curve where each call date risks one unit spread equally across that day's calls: R assumes equal risk, % assumes equal dollars held the full window with no stop.

hindsight.note: Live forward record only. A bucket's hit-rate appears once it has >=5 resolved calls. Diagnostic check on whether our conviction score predicts follow-through -- not (yet) fed back into it.
